title: The Marriage of Zelophehad's Daughters
description: The heads of the clans from Manasseh's family came to Moses and the leaders with a concern: If Zelophehad's daughters marry men from other tribes, their inheritance will be lost to their father's tribe. On the Lord's command, Moses gave an instruction that the daughters must marry within their father's tribe. Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah followed this command and married sons of their uncles in Manasseh's family, so that the inheritance remained within the tribe. This is among the last commands the Lord gave through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan.
